description: Default retention and erasure rules for L1-alpha life store. Counsel addendum should reference this file by contract_version.

memory_link.note: User may dismiss an edge in UI without deleting underlying thread/note/link.

summary_projection.note: Summaries are derived; may be rebuilt from turns until source turns are erased.

erasure_scopes.all: Delete all L1 artifacts for userId; leave auth record to Firebase ops unless account deletion.
erasure_scopes.thread: Delete thread + cascaded turns + summaries referencing those turns; notes/links with only this threadId unlinked or erased per product rule.
erasure_scopes.turn: Delete single turn; regenerate or invalidate summaries listing turnId.
erasure_scopes.note: Delete note; remove memory_link edges involving noteId.
erasure_scopes.link: Delete link; remove memory_link edges involving linkId.
erasure_scopes.summaries_only: Delete summary_projection rows only; threads/turns remain.
